problem.title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays Without Extra Space
problem.problemStatement: Given two sorted arrays, merge them so that the first array contains the smallest elements and the second array contains the remaining elements, without using extra space.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and M. • Second line contains N sorted integers. • Third line contains M sorted integers.
